reasoning: The icon shows an upward arrow inside a dashed circle, commonly read as upload, pending upload, or version upgrade. While useful for abstract file-upload or system-upgrade tasks where no concrete physical object dominates, it is fairly generic and easily confused with other directional or status-circle arrows.
